nse:106837394.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106837394.answer: Management did not provide specific consolidated revenue or margin target numbers for Q2 FY27 on recent calls. In July 2026, Retail management explicitly noted they had "not put any margin target," aiming instead to double absolute EBITDA over three years. In October 2026, management noted H1 O2C performance was tracking an annualized EBITDA well over ₹80,000 crore.

evidence.quote: As far as our absolute EBITDA is going up, we are happy and that is why if you look at it, we have not put any margin target

So, when you look at the first half of FY 2027 performance, it is in our minds tracking annualized EBITDA well over Rs.80,000 Crores and I think this is something, it just tells you how the markets are

nse:106836523.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106836523.answer: Management did not give explicit numerical revenue or margin targets for Q2 FY27 in prior calls. In Q1 FY27, management noted percentage margin compression from expired PLI 1 and higher component prices passed through to selling prices. In Q2 FY27, Dixon reported revenue of ₹21,793.6 crore (+46.7% YoY) and EBITDA margin of 2.7% versus 3.8% YoY.

evidence.quote: Operating margin for the quarter reflected temporary compression on account of expiry of Mobile PLI 1 in March '26 and from increased selling prices driven by elevated input costs and broader supply chain inflationary factors
As increased input costs were passed through increase in selling prices, percentage margins look optically lower, mostly in mobile and IT hardware business

The pass-through of higher input cost through corresponding increasing in selling prices resulted in a lower reported margin percentage, particularly in mobile and IT hardware business, despite the recovery of increased cost through pricing adjustments

nse:106845578.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106845578.answer: Management previously guided FY27 revenue of ~₹825 crore and PAT of ~₹137 crore. Following an October 2026 TLS certificate incident, they revised guidance in November 2026 to ~₹800 crore revenue and ~₹125 crore PAT. Management targets EBITDA margins around 25%. Q2 FY27 results (Revenue ₹207 crore, EBITDA margin 24.0%) align with these lowered expectations.

evidence.quote: At the start of the year, we guided a revenue of about INR 825 crores and PAT of about INR 137 crores, about 25% PAT growth. We now expect our revenue to be about INR 800 crore and PAT of around INR 125 crore
EBITDA margins are around the 25%. That we will try and maintain because, obviously, our focus is more on the solutions business, which is anyway slightly high gross margins

nse:106834360.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106834360.answer: In July 2026 (Q1 FY27 call), management expected Q2 PRASK revenue growth of over 25% YoY. In November 2026 (Q2 FY27 call), management confirmed PRASK grew 31%, beating guidance. Revenue matched expectations, rising 25.9% YoY to ₹23,363.8 crore. Margins improved YoY with EBITDA margin rising to 8.2% (from 3.1%), though elevated fuel costs resulted in a ₹1,879.1 crore net loss.

evidence.quote: In terms of unit passenger revenue or PRASK for Q2FY27, with the current balanced demand￾supply equation and the higher fares holding up, we are expecting growth of more than 25% compared to the same period last year
Third, in this environment, we delivered a 31 percent increase in PRASK, which exceeded our guidance of more than 25 percent growth
In terms of profitability, EBITDAR came in at 25 billion rupees, at a margin of around 11 percent, compared to an EBITDAR of 11 billion rupees and a margin of 6 percent for the same period last year

nse:106836275.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106836275.answer: In the August 2026 (Q1 FY27) and November 2026 (Q2 FY27) calls, management maintained full-year FY27 guidance of high single-digit top-line revenue growth, without providing specific numerical margin targets. The reported Q2 FY27 revenue growth of 11.9% YoY (₹16,198.7 crore) exceeded this full-year top-line expectation.

evidence.quote: Think we should stick on to the high single-digit growth for the full year
Regarding the guidance, I think we'll stick to what guidance we have given at the beginning of the year

nse:106834087.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106834087.answer: In July 2026 (Q1 FY27 call), management guided for an 8–10% full-year volume growth band and maintained an 18–20% PBDIT margin guidance for FY27, noting Q2 is traditionally a lower-margin quarter due to product mix. The Q2 results saw standalone volume grow 6.4% and consolidated EBITDA margin drop to 15.6%, though H1 EBITDA margin remained within the 18–20% band.

evidence.quote: What we have seen is that quarter two has traditionally been a lower margin because of the mix of what we sell in quarter two overall. Given the fact that, we are taking a very strong drive in terms of premiumization, of how we want to go ahead from an overall mix. We are still garnering around the guidance of 18-20% of our PBDIT margins holds

As we go ahead, possibly some of those indications will also look at whether price changes would happen in the second half, which could trigger demand even further. At the current stage, we are looking at the band of 8-10% for the full FY27
The great thing to look at is that the PBDIT margin growth at a half-year level is very good and the PBDIT margin is in the higher range of the overall band of what we have been speaking at 19.6%

nse:106836183.question: What has management said about raising money: how much, why, and what it is for?
nse:106836183.answer: Management reported completing a ₹780 crore QIP in Q1 FY27 and a subsequent 60:40 partly paid rights issue to strengthen liquidity, deleverage, and gain financial flexibility. Most raised cash went toward adding capacity or paying down debt. Additionally, they plan to raise external equity directly into the cell company to expand capacity from 6 GWh to 20 GWh.

evidence.quote: The balance sheet strengthened during the quarter through the successful completion of a ₹780 crore QIP, giving us greater financial flexibility as we pursue the next phase of our growth
Most of the cash we have raised has gone either into adding capacity or into paying down debt during this period
Once we stabilise 6 GWh, over the next couple of quarters, we will definitely look to go to 20 GWh, and we will do that by bringing external equity into the cell company

nse:106867910.question: What has management said on recent calls about leadership, succession or this role?
nse:106867910.answer: In April 2026 (Q4 FY26), management stated the leadership transition was largely complete after onboarding heads of Retail Banking, Global Markets, Chief Risk Officer, and Chief Information Officer. The Board approved appointing Jagdeep Mallareddy and Ganesh Sankaran as Executive Director designates. In July 2026 (Q1 FY27), management highlighted focus shifted to execution under the strengthened leadership team.

evidence.quote: Our leadership transition is now largely completed, and the strengthened leadership team brings diverse experience, and a strong execution mindset
The Board has approved appointment of Jagdeep Mallareddy and Ganesh Sankaran as Whole Time Executive Director Designate
During the quarter, our focus was on strengthening the franchise, operating model and execution capabilities under the new leadership team to create a stronger foundation for future growth

nse:106839459.question: What has management said about this on its recent calls?
nse:106839459.answer: In the Nov 2026 Q2 FY27 call, management stated it voluntarily recalled 11 ophthalmology products and voluntarily initiated a temporary cessation of manufacturing activities, keeping Indian regulators informed. Management took remedial actions regarding product quality and patient safety to resolve the issue shortly, while declining to comment on specific media reports.

evidence.quote: No, Vishal, I can't comment on what media has reported. But what I can say is that there are 11 ophthalmology products, which we have voluntarily recalled. And we voluntarily initiated a temporary cessation of our manufacturing activities, and we have kept the Indian regulator informed about it
I think what is most important for us is the product quality and patient safety. And we have taken a remedial action so that we can put everything in place shortly

nse:106856770.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106856770.answer: Management guided in August 2026 that gross margins would remain around 30-32% over the next quarter or two. In November 2026, management stated that gross margins would come down a bit in Q3 and Q4 due to the dealer transition and dealer commissions, while operating margins would improve meaningfully. The Q2 FY27 results show revenue of ₹420.0 crore and an EBITDA margin of -51.9%.

evidence.quote: Our gross-margin target is around 30-32%, which is where we want it to be, and opex continues to improve structurally
Going forward, as we said in the shareholders’ letter, gross margin will come down a bit in Q3 and Q4 because the business model transitions to the dealer model, and dealers take a certain commission

nse:106854012.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106854012.answer: Management did not discuss this on its last two calls.

nse:106847388.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106847388.answer: Management did not provide quantitative consolidated revenue or margin guidance for Q2 FY27 in the Q1 FY27 call. Instead, they discussed segment-level trends, highlighting sustained momentum in Africa, continuing digital business growth in B2B alongside wholesale margin pressure, and general expectations of organic ARPU expansion driving operating leverage.

evidence.quote: I think, longer term, as the portfolio retools, we think the margins will be in this ballpark, maybe sort of trend slightly downwards as we see the step up in the digital portfolio, but the real metric for us that we should be looking at is faster revenue growth because ultimately this market, as we have repeatedly stressed, is very large and all of it depends on our ability to execute

On return on capital, I think I would just simply say that, look, our focus right now is, if we can continue to grow the business, extract operating leverage, then those are outcomes that come out and we do not set those as targets because there are different ways of actually meeting that, including making short term decisions on reducing capex and that is something that we do not do as a business
